provider: RUVDS "Большой диск" / СХД — Russian flat-rate disk VPS with unlimited traffic

free_tier.stated: СХД Старт 1,023 ₽/mo for 1,024 GB; СХД Стандарт 1,899 ₽/mo for 2,048 GB; СХД Премиум 3,798 ₽/mo for 4,096 GB. Line advertised «от 1 до 18 Терабайт». Landing headline: «всего 500₽ за 1 Тб/мес».
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that no cap exists
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: no retention statement was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that retention is unlimited
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Unlimited — every СХД configuration lists its channel (up to 100 Mbit/s on the entry tiers) with no traffic meter, and the service is sold as a VPS so the rail is the VPS's own port. No per-GB charge exists.

tooling: Full KVM VPS: SSH, SFTP, rsync, rclone, MinIO/Nextcloud self-hosted, NFS/Samba. This is the most flexible option in the dossier because you control the software stack (so you can run MinIO and get an S3 endpoint yourself).
chaining: Config-doubling ladder up to 18 TB; 20 TB requires two units or a different product. Each 1 TB step costs the same per TB from 2 TB upward.
limits_note: The «500 ₽ per 1 TB/mo» headline is NOT the price of the СХД plans — the cheapest actual 1 TB plan is 1,023 ₽. The 500 ₽ figure refers to a base VPS plus a per-TB disk add-on in the order configurator, and reproducing it requires assembling that configuration. 100 Mbit/s on the entry tier caps the serving workload at ~1 TB/day theoretical, ~32 TB/month, which is just enough for 1 TiB/day but with no headroom. Russian jurisdiction and card.
reliability_note: Long-established Russian host (ruvds.com), KVM, own DCs. No independent benchmark of the СХД disk subsystem was found; these are HDD-backed large-disk plans and random-read performance will be poor — fine for archive, wrong for the 10 TiB hot set. The gap between the advertised 500 ₽/TB and the actual 1,023 ₽/TB entry plan is the single biggest pricing-presentation discrepancy in this dossier and should be re-quoted at order time.

extras.agent_focus: Wave 7 cheap-PAID lane, regional angle: storage sold in RUB / CNY / BRL / INR / ZAR / TRY / PLN / UAH that never appears on Western price lists. Every paid candidate carries price_per_tb_month at USD-converted list price. FX fixed 2026-10-21 from open.er-api.com: RUB 82.5719/USD, CNY 6.6913, BRL 5.0231, INR 94.9952, ZAR 16.3972, TRY 49.5978, PLN 3.8923, UAH 45.0922, EUR 0.89075/USD. Excluded per brief: AWS, Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, IDrive e2. Headline result: the true regional floor with genuinely free egress is ~$2.00/TB/mo (Yandex 360 Profi 3 TB on a Russian card) rising to ~$4.17/TB/mo for the same product bought with a foreign card, and ~$5.95-7.56/TB/mo for flat-rate Western-facing file storage (TheHost, Rollin Host). Everything advertised below ~$2/TB/mo in this set is either capacity-capped, egress-metered, or unverifiable marketing.

binding_note: one stream is shaped, and the client's throughput is the shaped rate times the number of streams
